news.text: #Spalletti and #Allegri, never friends, with the fear of dropping out of the race.At 8:45 PM, #Juve-#Napoli[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
Max Becomes Lucio's Judge#Juve-#Napoli (8:45 PM): #Spalletti at the crossroads. #Allegri: "They are writing them off as dead, I don't believe it".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

A MATTER OF RESPECTAgainst #Napoli, #Juve is called upon for a surge of dignity.The team tonight is expected to give a strong response: they owe it to themselves, to the fans, and to the history (the club celebrates its 129th anniversary today). #Spalletti: "Yes, we need to win back the respect that has been taken from us". #Allegri: "Watch out, they are not dead".[Front Page TuttoSport]
🔴 Probable lineup #Juventus: Vicario; Bremer, Lucumi, Kelly; Kalulu, McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Cabal; Kolo Muani, Woltemade.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙❌ "Performances like the one in Genoa will no longer be tolerated. It is the players who are at the center of the problem: there is no desire to fight, to run those extra meters, that aggression that is needed in matches. There is something that must be changed immediately in the players' attitude. Then, it is clear that there are other problems to address, such as the many injuries."[Giovanni Guardalà via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹😶‍🌫️ "For #Cambiaso, it is not a technical or tactical issue, but above all an attitude one. He hasn't suddenly become a flop, but he plays with a complacency that is indefensible for anyone wearing the #Juventus shirt. The lapses in attention and concentration are unacceptable: he must be careful, otherwise the club might even prefer a #NextGen player over him."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

#Spalletti in 3️⃣ points pre #JuveNapoli 🗣️ “I am used to many moments experienced in my career, loaded with difficulties. I don't need anything, just the reaction from the team.”🗣️ “#Carnevali was perfect. He hit the right buttons”🗣️ “If anyone thinks that I will back down or retreat even a tiny bit from my work, my obligation, my pursuit, they should better start expecting something different.”@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

LUCIANO SPALLETTI’S PRESS CONFERENCE AHEAD OF JUVENTUS-NAPOLIThe Juventus coach’s words ahead of the clash against Napoli, discussing the team’s current situation, the determination to bounce back and Juventus’ birthday.Luciano Spalletti spoke to the media in his pre-match press conference ahead of Juventus-Napoli, reflecting on the team’s current form, the need to return to winning ways and the Club’s 129th birthday on 1 November.JUVENTUS’ BIRTHDAY AND THE DETERMINATION TO BOUNCE BACK“I wish for Juventus to fulfil the hopes of its fans, to see a team that delivers what the supporters want to see. 🇮🇹👀 "#Vicario is doing quite well, he is showcasing his abilities and is one of the few players who, after defeats, presents himself before the journalists and goes to the stands. He puts himself out there, wants to stay at #Juventus and hopes to be signed permanently and continue as a bianconero. There is the possibility of purchasing him at a bargain price: €8M + €2M in bonuses. A three-year contract is already ready."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🤵‍♂️ℹ️ "#Carnevali does not want a caretaker manager, but everything will depend on the results: in these three matches, #Spalletti is playing for a great deal. The CEO holds this opinion as a matter of principle and because he knows it could hinder future plans: it would mean putting strategies on standby or reformulating them. However, that doesn't mean he would not intervene: if the team fails to give clear signs, he would take a decision regardless."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 More behind-the-scenes from the match between #Genoa and #Juventus: Luciano #Spalletti had already noticed the problem with #Baldanzi's positioning.He told the bench: "We have to swap #Sarr with Douglas, because Douglas never gets there."Afterward, he called #McKennie and asked him to tell the two midfielders to exchange positions.The tactical change arrived too late, with the match already 2-0.In the stands, according to the lip-reading from the footage, Giovanni #Carnevali appears to say: "But how the f*** can you play like this?"The next day he went to speak with the squad at la Continassa.[DAZN Pitchside Camera via @tuttosport - @PuebloJ]

🆙🧐 #Spalletti wants to provide a shake-up not only on a mental level, but also through new tactical solutions. He is evaluating a return to the 4-3-3, with #Zhegrova on the right, #Boga on the left and #KoloMuani as the striker. Changes also in midfield: #Koopmeiners is a candidate to take #Sarr's spot to play alongside #DouglasLuiz and #McKennie. In defense #Kalulu-#Bremer-#Lucumi-#Kelly.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
"Insults and offensive language" directed at referee Mariani during #Portugal - #Norway in the #NationsLeague: 3-match suspension for the juventino Francisco #Conceição.[Mirko Nicolino]

👀 Giovanni #Carnevali firmly intends to draw a continuous and stable line at #Juventus, even in the midst of a full crisis, following the defeats against #Lazio and #Genoa.Luciano #Spalletti is going to have the opportunity to recover without being singled out as the sole culprit.The difficulties, including financial ones, accumulated over time and cannot be resolved immediately.In the last six years, five managers have passed through #Juve: #Pirlo, #Allegri, #ThiagoMotta, #Tudor and #Spalletti.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]
🚑 Arkadiusz #Milik returned to training with the #Juventus group as part of his recovery process.He is not going to be available against #Napoli.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

👀 #Juventus reiterated full confidence in Luciano #Spalletti and confirmed its willingness to continue with him: he is not under discussion and the club is not evaluating alternatives.It is considered that the difficulties are linked above all to the attitude and errors of the players, and not to the technical-tactical decisions of the coach.The management held the team responsible and demanded an immediate reaction.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

👀 Luciano #Spalletti decided that the entire #Juventus squad will participate in the training retreat at the JHotel, including the players who are unavailable due to physical problems.The decision includes Kenan #Yildiz, Manuel #Locatelli and Khéphren #Thuram, in addition to the other injured players.The only exception should be the goalkeeper #Grabara, who is still in Poland.#Spalletti wants to avoid division in the locker room and hold the entire group responsible.Tactically, the 3-5-2 is still the primary option against #Napoli, but switching to a four-man defense with a 4-3-3 is not ruled out.[@tuttosport via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]

🚨💣 EXCL | Juventus have just contacted Julian Nagelsmann, adding the German coach to their preferred alternatives should they decide to replace Spalletti.The former Germany boss is weighing several options for his future and appreciated the Bianconeri's approach. 👀⚪⚫[Rudy Galetti]
